records.issue_text: `force: true` in db/migrate/20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb drops any pre-existing topic_embeds table and recreates it empty, silently deleting every embed_url → topic_id mapping if run against a DB where the table already has rows
records.rationale: The migration `db/migrate/20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb` explicitly uses `create_table :topic_embeds, force: true`, which in Rails will drop the table if it already exists and recreate it. If a DB already has a `topic_embeds` table with rows, running this migration would wipe those `embed_url`→`topic_id` mappings (and any other data) by dropping/recreating the table.

records.issue_text: Data loss from the topic_embeds drop orphans the original topics: the next PollFeed/TopicRetriever pass finds no TopicEmbed for the URL and creates duplicate topics for the same article, while the original topics can never be updated again — irreversible with no backup step
records.rationale: The diff does not include any migration that drops `topic_embeds` or deletes existing `TopicEmbed` rows. It only adds a new `CreateTopicEmbeds` migration (with `create_table :topic_embeds, force: true`) and code that uses `TopicEmbed` to avoid duplicates. The finding’s premise (“drop orphans the original topics” / “no backup step”) is not shown in the PR diff.
